interpretation: 32/1657 GPS sentences cross deadlines (1.93%), maximum sentence lateness 0.354 ms, versus 75/1057 (7.10%) and 1.825 ms before character yielding. Observational comparison, not a controlled causal estimate. Normal slots still show 156 shallow crossings, maximum 0.386 ms, with zero accumulated-duration overruns and zero coalesced ticks. Heap ends 32 B above start, zero allocation failures, largest free block unchanged. Button recovery has 3 coalesced ticks and delays; slot 78 also has an unexplained normal barometer-call delay and needs follow-up. This capture does not establish wider individual GPS bursts from the phase chart.

baseline_notes: Reference for this Navigate workload and hardware only. Requalify if measurement schema, clock, capture footprint, toolchain, slot schedule or workload changes. original_limitations: Short manual bench run with at least 114 normal samples per slot; not automated operational qualification. Prior clean run is 80.691 seconds; durations, GPS phase and GSV counts differ, so formal baseline comparison is withheld. Enabled radios do not establish verified traffic. No independent full-profiler overhead calibration or hardware UART overflow counters. No claim of long-term memory stability or sensor-recovery correctness. A normal slot-78 start/barometer delay of 7.663/7.719 ms is retained only as a maximum; its event predecessor is unavailable and its cause cannot be reconstructed.
